results.name: Active Single Seniors
results.description: A social group for single seniors that gets together for easy-to-moderate hikes and outings around Asheville, with the goal of getting to know each other and having fun.
results.notes: Meetup group; hikes at Arboretum, Bent Creek etc. Last event July 2026, none upcoming.

results.name: Anti-Running Walking Club
results.description: A low-pressure walking club that strolls the French Broad River greenways for fresh air and conversation rather than pace.
results.notes: New Meetup group, only one inaugural walk (April 2026). Kept as grey.

results.name: Land of the Sky Chorus
results.description: A men's a cappella barbershop chorus that rehearses weekly and welcomes guests and new singers of all experience levels.
results.notes: Meetup events are Land of the Sky Chorus rehearsals; chapter est. 1948 (BHS). No confirmed own site URL found.

results.name: Asheville Board Game Club
results.description: A weekly public meetup for casual tabletop play, from strategy to party and cooperative games, with teaching for newcomers.
results.home_base: Well Played Board Game Cafe, Asheville
results.notes: Events listed via Well Played cafe; recurring regulars plausible. No own website found.

results.name: Asheville Crokinole Club
results.description: A community of crokinole players who meet weekly in a brewery taproom to flick discs, play casual rounds and welcome newcomers.
results.notes: Confirmed on Highland Brewing calendar; free, boards provided; upcoming events.

results.name: Asheville Gay Men's Chorus
results.description: A nonprofit community chorus for the LGBTQ and affirming community, affiliated with GALA Choruses. It rehearses, performs and auditions new singers.
results.notes: Known site; 501(c)(3) chorus with standing membership; events are performances and auditions.

results.name: Asheville Lose The Booze Crew
results.description: A social group for sober and sober-curious adults in their 20s to 40s, with coffee walks, trivia, climbing and other alcohol-free outings.
results.notes: Meetup group, 16 events, recent activity through late Sept 2026.

results.name: Asheville Practical Philosophy and Spirituality Meetup
results.description: A discussion circle where attendees submit real-life questions, vote on one, and talk it through in an open, nonjudgmental setting.
results.notes: Meetup group, 19 events at Character Study, last Aug 2026.

results.name: Asheville Social Club
results.description: A general social club that organizes rooftop meetups, paddling and kayaking trips, game nights and other outings for meeting new people.
results.notes: Meetup group, 23 events through Sept 2026.

results.name: Asheville Travel Club
results.description: A club for travelers to swap trip ideas and plan group travel, from international destinations to US getaways.
results.notes: Meetup group, one meet and greet Sept 2026; new group, kept as grey.

results.name: AVL Digital Nomads
results.description: A community of remote workers, freelancers and entrepreneurs that meets at coworking spaces for talks, book clubs, coworking sessions and social events.
results.notes: Meetup group, 100 events, upcoming events; broad community with returning members.

results.name: BiggerPockets Asheville Meetup
results.description: A local meetup for real estate investors to share deals, ideas and advice with peers.
results.notes: Peer investor meetup, 2 events in spring 2026. Borderline networking; kept as grey.

results.name: Burton Street Community Association
results.description: A neighborhood association for residents of the historically African American Burton Street community in West Asheville, meeting monthly on local issues and projects.
results.notes: Association est. 1967; monthly meetings listed by City of Asheville. No own site found.

results.name: Come Sit With Us
results.description: A weekly community meditation group combining spiritual teaching, guided meditation and silence, open to beginners and people of any belief.
results.notes: Meetup and Eventbrite events, led by AJ Anantadev Das; upcoming events.

results.name: Cue The Pub Run
results.description: A weekly Wednesday group run that finishes at a brewery taproom, open to all ages and experience levels.
results.notes: 20 weekly events at Archetype Brewing through July 2026. No own site found.

results.name: Carver Edible Park Community Workday
results.description: Volunteers who tend the Dr. George Washington Carver Edible Park, a public food forest, with seasonal planting, weeding and composting workdays.
results.home_base: Carver Edible Park, East End, Asheville
results.notes: City park page confirms volunteer stewardship (Buncombe Fruit Nut Club, East End neighbors). Monthly workdays.

results.name: Fairview Library Fiber Arts Club
results.description: A monthly gathering for people who knit, crochet or do other fiber crafts. Not instructional, and newcomers are welcome.
results.notes: Library-hosted monthly club, 3 listings Jul-Sep 2026.

results.name: Friends Who Dine
results.description: A social group that meets at local restaurants for lunches and dinners to meet new people over a shared meal.
results.notes: Meetup group, 6 events Aug-Sept 2026.

results.name: Hendersonville Euchre Inebriati Group
results.description: A card group that plays Euchre over drinks on regular Thursday nights, with quick lessons for beginners.
results.notes: Meetup group, 8 events Jan-Aug 2026; host-run but recurring regulars likely.

results.name: In Curiosity Of Healing
results.description: A circle for practicing intuition, meditation and energy awareness with a like-minded group, plus low-cost energy healing sessions.
results.notes: Meetup circle hosted at a practitioner's studio; borderline business but community circles. Kept as grey.

results.name: Joy Seekers Unite
results.description: A social group built around laughter and connection, starting with a costume karaoke night and other lighthearted meetups.
results.notes: New Meetup group, one karaoke event March 2026. Grey, kept.

results.name: Leveling Up With Lattes
results.description: A peer goal-setting group that meets over coffee to share personal and professional goals, get group feedback and plan next steps.
results.notes: Meetup, 4 events Dec 2025 to Feb 2026; may be coach-led but peer round-robin format. Grey, kept.

results.name: Mary Magdalene Monthly Sacred Circle
results.description: A monthly sacred circle with ritual workshops on the Mary Magdalene path.
results.notes: Only listing is a paid $111 workshop (Create Your Own Alchemy) by one practitioner; no member community.

results.name: Menopause Matters
results.description: A monthly discussion and support series for people in perimenopause, menopause or post-menopause, with guest speakers and group conversation.
results.notes: Hosted by menopause coach Lisa Witler (WitFit) with AARP; grey since host-led, but ongoing community. Last event Feb 2026.

results.name: Mountain Haulers
results.description: A DIY bike group with a weekly no-drop social ride from the River Arts District, with regrouping and social breaks along the way.
results.notes: Listed by Asheville on Bikes with 25 upcoming rides; Instagram handle from event text.

results.name: Oklawaha Wednesday Bluegrass Jam
results.description: A weekly pickup bluegrass and old-time jam in a brewery taproom where pickers of all skill levels and listeners are welcome.
results.notes: Brewery-hosted jam with house trio Finkelstein 3; kept per owner greenlight. Last listing Jan 2026.

results.name: Pack Library Romance Book Club
results.description: A monthly book club that reads and discusses romance novels, with newcomers always welcome.
results.notes: Library-hosted monthly club confirmed in event descriptions.

results.name: Rad Parent Meetup
results.description: A monthly discussion circle for parents and caregivers to support each other and talk through raising kids in difficult times.
results.notes: Events listed on firestorm.coop; community-run, monthly.

results.name: Sacred Anarchy Book Club
results.description: A community-led book club exploring magic, animism and spirituality in liberation movements, held at an Asheville bookstore co-op.
results.notes: Events listed on firestorm.coop; monthly community-led.

results.name: Silicon Dojo Asheville
results.description: Free tech classes on AI and Python programming taught at local libraries.
results.notes: Instructor-led classes where only the host recurs; attendees rotate. Four events spring 2026.

results.name: Southside After Praise
results.description: A weekly afternoon of spades and dominoes at a community center after church services, open to neighbors.
results.notes: 47 weekly listings at Dr. Wesley Grant Sr. Southside Community Center, upcoming events.

results.name: Sunrise AA Meeting
results.description: A morning Alcoholics Anonymous discussion meeting held through the Asheville 12 Step Club, with online access.
results.notes: Meeting-finder listing shows Sunday 7 AM at the 12 Step Club with online option; events listed as virtual.

results.name: The Compassionate Friends of Blue Ridge
results.description: A local chapter of The Compassionate Friends offering peer grief support to family members after the death of a child.
results.notes: Chapter of national org; monthly meetings. Chapter page not found in search.

results.name: Trillium Events
results.description: Ticketed events and workshops for femme DJs and music community.
results.notes: Event-producer page selling ticketed workshops (Femme Frequency DJ). Only 2 events.

results.name: We Hike to Heal Asheville
results.description: A local chapter of We Hike to Heal that leads free women's mindful hikes in Pisgah and nearby forests, focused on nature and emotional healing.
results.schedule: Occasional, a few times a year
results.notes: Ambassador-led free hikes on Eventbrite; national site not verified, so website left null.

results.name: Western North Carolina Scale Model Club
results.description: A non-profit club for static scale model builders to show finished and in-progress models and share tips, for all skill levels.
results.notes: Library listings describe a non-profit club; events through Sept 2026.

results.name: WNC Prostate Support Group
results.description: A volunteer-led peer support group on prostate health and cancer, meeting online and in person, open to men, family and supporters.
results.notes: Website taken from event listing URLs; monthly meetings with upcoming dates.

results.name: Y12SR: Yoga and 12 Step Recovery
results.description: A recovery group that combines gentle yoga with 12 step tools, open to anyone affected by substance use or behavioral health concerns.
results.notes: Y12SR is a national program; this series at ACNC wellness center had 3 sessions Apr-May 2026.
